args.title: Halvorsen Supply Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights autonomous carts and links to a deeper article plus a companion piece (registered using daniel.ferreira@northwind.example).
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest cost/efficiency saving came from a reduction in mis-picks.
